candidates.name: MDRP Ghost-NDC Monitor
candidates.one_line: Quarterly pre-computed PDF telling a pharma labeler exactly which of its NDCs are active in the CMS Medicaid Drug Rebate file but dead in FDA's own NDC Directory (and which package NDCs conflict), before CMS's new misclassification penalties or a state rebate dispute finds them first.
candidates.buyer: Government-pricing / regulatory-operations manager at mid-size pharma manufacturers, generics houses and repackagers participating in the Medicaid Drug Rebate Program (Hikma, Lupin, Apotex, Amneal, Rising, American Health Packaging tier and below).
candidates.buyer_solvency: [VERIFIED] Solvent by construction: every prospect holds a CMS national rebate agreement and sells into Medicaid. From the CMS file itself (2026Q1 snapshot): 690 labelers with active NDCs; 270 labelers have >=20 active NDCs, 172 have >=50, 110 have >=100. Top holders are Hikma (1.060), Fresenius Kabi (1.052), Dr. Reddy's (807), Lupin (797), Takeda — multi-hundred-million to multi-billion revenue firms. Defect concentrates in the LARGE catalogs (Lupin 118 mismatches, Hospira 66, Apotex 62, Takeda 35), i.e. complexity not poverty.
candidates.source_a: CMS 'Drug Products in the Medicaid Drug Rebate Program', quarterly CSV, https://download.medicaid.gov/data/drugproducts1q_2026_05082026.csv (321MB, fetched HTTP 200)
candidates.source_b: FDA NDC Directory full extract, https://download.open.fda.gov/drug/ndc/drug-ndc-0001-of-0001.json.zip (28MB, fetched HTTP 200); direction-check via DailyMed SPL API (dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/services/v2/spls.json)
candidates.the_defect: "CMS's current Medicaid rebate file shows NDC 00409-0040-05 (Ketamine HCl 500mg/5mL) as ACTIVE under your labeler code with no termination date, but that NDC has no listing in FDA's NDC Directory and no SPL on DailyMed — one of your two federal submissions is wrong. You have 66 such NDCs plus 14 package-code conflicts." Recipient can verify both values in two free federal lookups in under a minute.
candidates.defect_rate: MEASURED on full population: of 44.414 active 2026Q1 MDRP NDCs, 2.374 (5,3% raw) have no product-level FDA listing; filtered to Market Date before 2024 to strip launch-lag: 2.225 (5,0% clean). Separately 6.465 (14,6%) have the product but not the exact package NDC in FDA's file. Direction sample: 40 of 40 random product-level mismatches had zero active DailyMed SPL — i.e. dead-at-FDA-but-active-at-CMS, a reporting failure the manufacturer must fix on one side or the other. Residual false-positive risk: terminations that occurred in the last quarter where CMS reporting is not yet due (not fully strippable from one snapshot; the raw-vs-clean gap and the pre-2024 market-date filter bound it).
